tex_content.html: \begin{equation} D^+\mu (t)\le ((2n-1)A_{\sup }(t))\, \mu (t), \qquad A_{\sup }(t)=\sup _{x\in M}|\operatorname {Rm}_{g(t)}(x)|. \end{equation} Here $D^+f(t)\le c$ means that, for every $\eta >0$, all sufficiently small $h>0$ satisfy $(f(t+h)-f(t))/h\le c+\eta $.
